(async()=>{const {createCamera}=await import('/base/camera.js');const park=await fetch('/tests/park-crowd/park.json').then(r=>r.json());const cam=createCamera(park);const {walk,rides}=__crowd;const by=new Map(walk.nodes.map(n=>[n.id,n]));const lines=[],points=[];for(const e of walk.edges){const a=by.get(e.a),b=by.get(e.b);if(a.h<-20&&b.h<-20)continue;lines.push([a.px,b.px,e.kind]);}for(const p of walk.places){if((p.h??0)<-20)continue;for(const s of p.slots)points.push([s[0],s[1],p.kind]);if(p.gate)points.push([p.gate[0],p.gate[1],'gate']);if(p.slots.length>1)for(let i=0;i<p.slots.length-1;i++)lines.push([p.slots[i],p.slots[i+1],'queue']);const n=by.get(p.node);if(n)lines.push([p.slots.at(-1),n.px,'approach'])}const deck=walk.nodes.filter(n=>n.kind!=='place'&&n.kind!=='exit'&&n.h>-20);for(const r of rides)for(const e of r.entries)if(e.exit){points.push([e.exit[0],e.exit[1],'exit']);const g=cam.toGround(e.exit,0);let best=null,d=Infinity;for(const n of deck){const dd=Math.hypot(n.g[0]-g[0],n.g[2]-g[2]);if(dd<d){d=dd;best=n}}if(best)lines.push([e.exit,best.px,'exit leg'])}return JSON.stringify({about:'Where the crowd can stand on the deck (park px), dumped from the page by tests/park-crowd/tools/dump_reach.json: deck edges of the walking network with the rides queues, place slots, gates, exits and the straight leg from each exit to the node a group walks to first. Input of tests/park-crowd/tools/make_occluders.py.',lines,points})})()
